notes.title: Patch v1.02 & Trading Cards Up!
notes.content:
Patch v1.01: Fixed the bug afflicting the character screen menu.

Patch v1.02: Fixed the bug that occurs in Episode 4 during "Seeds of Disaster" where the screen becomes black and freezes with an error message.

Both patches are included in the latest update.

Trading cards are now fully available!
